description: This file defines build rules and installation procedures for Airoha firmware packages within an OpenWrt build system. It specifies how to install firmware binary files into the target firmware directory during the build process, including conditional handling for specific configurations.

methods.name: Package/airoha-en8811h-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines the installation process for the Airoha EN8811H firmware package, copying firmware files to the appropriate directory and conditionally creating a combined binary image.

methods.name: Package/airoha-en7581-npu-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines the installation process for the Airoha EN7581 NPU firmware package, copying specific firmware files into the target firmware directory.
